4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Turned in Sunday night: your answers to the How Electricity Works video, plus your TinkerCAD Circuits links (blink, button, dial). You turn it in once, at the end of Thursday's class.
4th Period.workingNow: Open the Google Classroom assignment called How Electricity Works. Watch the video from 0:00 to 8:25, answer in the Answers tab, add your circuit links, then turn in once at the end of class.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can explain what volts, amps, and ohms mean using the video, and my week's circuit links are turned in once.
